children: Chile’s annual inflation rate accelerated to 4.1% in August 2026 from 3.5% in the previous month.
The acceleration was mainly driven by higher price growth for food, which increased to 4.6% from 4.0%, and transport, which accelerated sharply to 6.8% from 4.6%.
Inflation for recreation, sport, and culture also picked up, rising to 6.4% from 4.4%.
Meanwhile, inflation stood at 3.4% for housing and utilities, at 6.6% for restaurants and lodging and 5.9% for education, while deflation in clothing and footwear eased to 4.0% from 4.8%.
In contrast, the decline in prices for insurance and financial services accelerated to 3.6% from 3.4%.
On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 0.6%, following a 0.1% increase in July.
Core consumer prices, which excludes food and energy, rose 0.4% over the month, unchanged from July.

title: Chile Annual Inflation Accelerates
